data.title: AI Era Linked to Weaker Pay and Jobs for College Graduates
data.description:
A new study found that the rise of artificial intelligence has coincided with a significant decline in initial earnings and employment among graduates in the most exposed college majors, according to Bloomberg.

The report said the trend could affect career outcomes for years afterward.

data.title: Puig to Buy Remaining Isdin Stake for €1.2 Billion
data.description: Puig Brands SA agreed to buy the remaining 50% of skincare brand Isdin it did not already own for €1.2 billion ($1.4 billion), according to Bloomberg. The deal gives Puig full control of Isdin.

data.title: U.S. Refiners Rally As Crack Spreads Hit Near-Record Levels
data.description:
According to CNBC, independent oil refiners are benefiting from unusually wide crack spreads as U.S. diesel prices hit $6 per gallon for the first time and Brent crude rose 8.7% last week amid escalating Middle East tensions. Distillate inventories are about 14% below their five-year average, Saudi Arabia shut a key East-West crude pipeline to the Red Sea after damage in an Iraqi attack, and refining margins have risen about 60% quarter to date from the second quarter.

The article said global refining capacity has expanded on paper by 400,000 to 700,000 barrels per day over the past two years, but actual fuel production has fallen about 5%, or roughly 4.2 million barrels per day. It added that Western refiners are running at 98% to 103.5% of capacity, while rebuilding disrupted units and logistics could take 12 to 18 months.

Valero Energy shares are up more than 140% year to date and hit an intraday record of $399.40 on Monday before trading down nearly 2%. Marathon Petroleum has gained nearly 145% this year and reached an all-time intraday high of $409.50 on Monday before slipping less than 1% in midday trading. Phillips 66 has doubled year to date, touched a record $265.43 on Friday, and was down about 1% on Monday after its board approved a $10 billion increase to its buyback program in July.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says Oil Is Being Transported Through the Strait of Hormuz
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. President Donald Trump said oil is being transported through the Strait of Hormuz and that countries that have not helped the United States should compensate it after the conflict ends.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says U.S. High-End Weapons Production Is at a Record High
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, U.S. President Donald Trump said he had just received a report showing that the number of high-end weapons currently produced by the United States has reached a record high, with related equipment delivered daily to U.S. troops deployed in the Middle East and other regions. He said U.S. defense factories are operating around the clock, with each factory averaging four to five new large buildings under construction, and that the production focus includes Patriot missiles, THAAD missile defense systems, Tomahawk missiles and other Standard missile systems, while the United States currently holds large inventories of such equipment.

data.title: Nissan Americas Chairman Says Tariffs Accelerated U.S. Production
data.description:
Christian Meunier, chairman of Nissan Americas, said U.S. auto tariffs have been hard to manage but pushed Nissan to speed up localization and production in the United States, according to Bloomberg.

He said keeping products affordable in North America remains a challenge on Bloomberg Open Interest.

data.title: EU Draft Child Protection Law Targets Social Media, Online Games, and Chatbots
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the European Union's proposed draft child protection law would target social media, online games, and chatbot tools, and require fines of up to 6% of global revenue for related companies.

data.title: Hyperliquid Revenue Rises 100% Over 30 Days to $864 Million
data.description: HyperliquidNews said on X that Hyperliquid’s revenue rose 100% over the past 30 days to $864 million. According to Odaily, the figure was reported in a post on the social media platform X.

data.title: Claude Integrates With Charles Schwab, BlackRock, Addepar, and Orion
data.description: Claude has been integrated with Charles Schwab, BlackRock, Addepar, and Orion. According to ChainCatcher, the update adds support for these financial firms and platforms.

data.title: EmotionX to Launch Cloud Service for Encrypted Data Analysis
data.description: According to Nikkei Asia, EmotionX, a startup spun out of Japanese memory chip maker Kioxia Holdings, will offer a full-scale cloud service that lets encrypted data be analyzed without being decrypted.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Anthropic launches Claude model for financial advisers
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, Anthropic launched a Claude model for financial advisers that will connect with Charles Schwab, BlackRock, Addepar, and Orion.

data.title: New York City, Other Local Governments Sue DHS Over Trump Public-Benefits Rule
data.description: According to Axios, New York City and five other Democratic-led local governments sued the Department of Homeland Security to block a new Trump administration rule that they say could push immigrants and mixed-status families away from public benefits they can legally receive. The cities and counties said the rule, which takes effect this week, gives immigration officers broader discretion to deny green cards and visas based on immigrants' use of public benefits and could deter families from using Medicaid, SNAP and housing assistance. DHS estimates more than 950,000 people might disenroll or decline to enroll in public benefits, while the plaintiffs say the effect could be larger and could also lead U.S. citizen family members to withdraw from benefit programs.

data.title: STOCKS | Canada’s Carney Calls for Global AI Stability Board to Boost Safety
data.description:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said Canada wants to push for a global "technology stability" body to help oversee artificial intelligence development and ensure the technology is safe. According to Sina Finance, Carney said on Monday that coordination is needed and that, in his view, creating a technology stability board similar to the Financial Stability Board would make sense.

Carney also said the Canadian government will soon announce reforms to improve the competitiveness of its tax system and speed up federal approvals for major projects so they are completed within one year. He said foreign capital is underallocated to Canada.

On tensions in Canada-U.S. trade, Carney said he believes the two sides still have a chance to reach a "mutually beneficial" agreement to lower trade barriers. He said Canada is ready to sit down and negotiate, and added that he welcomed U.S. President Donald Trump’s remarks over the weekend that he believes the two countries may soon reach a deal.

At a summit Carney organized in Toronto, he and senior officials are preparing to pitch more than 100 global investors, including Blackstone, Temasek Holdings, and Apollo Global Management. Canada has prepared a list of investment projects, including more than 160 projects that need hundreds of billions of Canadian dollars in funding, although some are still at a very early planning stage.

The investment opportunities include a proposed crude oil pipeline to Canada’s west coast, the Ksi Lisims LNG export facility in British Columbia, and a data center campus in Alberta with a total investment of C$14.5 billion ($10.4 billion). The governments of Ontario and Alberta have also each prepared pitch books.

data.title: Ruihe Digital to Invest HK$60 Million in Naxin Technology IPO Placement
data.description:
Ruihe Digital Technology Solutions (3680) said it will use internal resources and proceeds from a previous placement to invest HK$60 million in Naxin Technology (9856) by subscribing to part of the company's international placement during its IPO, according to Ming Pao.

The company said the move reflects expected strategic synergies. It described the two businesses as complementary upstream and downstream participants in a software-plus-hardware model, with Naxin Technology supplying AI computing infrastructure hardware including optical modules and optical chips, while Ruihe Digital focuses on higher-level software services such as big data scheduling and AI algorithms.

data.title: US Private Credit Default Rate Reaches Record 6.3%, Fitch Says
data.description: The default rate for a group of US private debt borrowers rose to a record 6.3% in August, according to Fitch Ratings.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Warsh in Focus as G7 Rate-Hike Bets Build
data.description:
Central banks across much of the Group of Seven face a pivotal week as rising inflation risks increase pressure to raise interest rates, according to Bloomberg.

David Tinsley, senior economist at Bank of America, discussed the outlook for the US consumer and what he expects from the Federal Reserve's rate decision this week.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Citadel Securities Sees Europe Bond Yields Limited by Weak Growth
data.description:
Citadel Securities said Europe’s bond yields may be capped as the energy shock and central bank tightening weaken the region’s economy, according to Bloomberg.

The firm said the same forces that pushed yields higher could ultimately limit further gains.

data.title: U.S. President Donald Trump Says Iran Wants a Deal and Wants It Quickly
data.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Iran wants to reach a deal and wants to do so quickly and urgently. According to Odaily, Trump said he will decide whether the United States will engage with Iran and that the administration is open to that possibility.

data.title: U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve Crude Oil Inventories Fall to Lowest Since 1982
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) said U.S. Strategic Petroleum Reserve crude oil inventories fell by about 3.6 million barrels last week to 285 million barrels, the lowest level since 1982.

data.title: AI Startup Temporal Raises $550 Million at $12.55 Billion Valuation
data.description:
Temporal said it has completed a $550 million late-stage funding round at a valuation of $12.55 billion, more than double its valuation seven months ago. According to PANews, the round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with Wellington Management, Growth Equity under Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and Tiger Global as co-lead investors.

SV Angel and T. Rowe Price Associates advisory accounts also participated, while existing investors Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, and GIC joined the round again. The company said the funds will be used to expand global operations and further develop its platform.

Founded in 2019, Temporal develops open-source software that helps applications, including AI agents, recover from failures and reduces the need for engineers to write custom recovery code. Its customers include OpenAI, Snap, Nvidia, Netflix, and JPMorgan Chase.

Temporal said it has 570 employees and an annual recurring revenue run rate of more than $250 million, more than triple year over year. In February, the company raised $300 million in a round led by Andreessen Horowitz at a $5 billion valuation.
